item.title: Death on the Spot
item.description: Brigham Young declared interracial marriage punishable by 'death on the spot' as God's law. 150 years later, the LDS Church disavowed this teaching.

item.title: Flat Nose and Black Skin
item.description: Brigham Young taught that 'flat nose and black skin' were divine curses. This theology denied Black members priesthood for 119 years until 1978.

item.title: Devil's Representation
item.description: LDS President John Taylor taught God preserved the 'curse of Cain' through Noah's flood so 'the devil should have a representation upon the earth.'
